title: Concepto Creativo de Producto: Kit Pavlova Lab al Estilo Apple
prompt: A catchy 'Pavlova Lab Kit' in a clear acrylic organizer box with hinged lid. Input: Deconstructed Pavlova (Meringue nest, Whipped cream, Kiwifruit slices, Strawberries, Passionfruit pulp). Ingredients are raw and fresh. Graphic Style: Black line-art chemical formulas and timeline of Pavlova history printed on the lid and table. Minimalist sans-serif labels. A tiny 1:35 scale pastry chef figure inside the box is assembling the pavlova. Background: Blurred high-end white minimalist kitchen. Lighting: High-Key Clinical, bright diffuse daylight. 'Apple Product Photography' aesthetic.
